provenance.source: public Motorola XT2251-1 ONELI RETEU Android14 U2SLS34.1-42-14-11
provenance.method: Existing source-pinned Motorola ZIP64 range extraction with complete targeted read-only filesystem filename enumeration

fsg.caveat: Zero matches by path regex only; possible device-specific data under other filenames not excluded

limitations: Matching filenames and sha256 do not prove exact selected hardware revision, PCI subsystem/QMI board key or UART HCI ROM revision
These binaries are Motorola publicly distributed reference files, not a readback of handset-installed firmware
No Wi-Fi association, Bluetooth startup, secure signature validation, or oneli native Linux hardware test
No full repeated 4.35GB firmware download; only radio.img and BTFM.bin selected ZIP64 members were fetched
Existing VPU-specific firmware inventory used a narrow filename regex; this dedicated inventory supersedes its wireless absence
